authors_reviews.title: Writing this after using it for 3 weeks
authors_reviews.text: It certainly hits the spot for its target audience, its obviously not the best true wireless but for the price? It one of the best deals you can get.The ANC is good not great, as expected for the price range. Reduces Fan noise with ease in closed rooms but you can hear other ‘unwanted’ sounds if you are in a open space.No issues with the battery charged it once a week on heavy usage.As a person who strictly used IEMs only, Sound quality is great, but it is too bass heavy for me which reduces the clarity. But that’s subject.If you are using it on multiple devices, it will connect to the last device it was connected to by default. Compatible on both android and IOS

authors_reviews.title: Good earbuds with some room for improvement
authors_reviews.text: The earbuds have a good overall design and are comfortable for regular use. Sound quality is decent, especially for bass-heavy music, and the controls are convenient. The case is compact and easy to carry around.The ANC is useful for reducing background noise, although it doesn’t completely block out louder sounds. Battery backup is also reasonable for everyday listening.Overall, a decent option for the price, but there are a few areas where the audio and noise cancellation could be better.
